episodes.synopsis: Emu Hino, a lonely and beautiful Japanese artist witnesses a Chinese man killing three men, then sees his eyes well up with tears. He tells her the story of how the 108 Dragons turned him into the assassin, Crying Freeman.
episodes.title: Portrait of a Killer

episodes.synopsis: Yō and Emu marry in a Chinese wedding ceremony and are given the new names Long Tai Yang and Hu Qing Lan. Bai Ya Shan demands leadership of the 108 Dragons.
episodes.title: Shades of Death: Fusei Kakurei (1)

episodes.synopsis: Emu is kidnapped by 108 Dragon operatives, tortured and threatened with rape. Freeman's plane gets hijacked by Askari agents.
episodes.title: Shades of Death: Eternal Love (2)

episodes.synopsis: Dark Eyes is confronted by the massive and powerful Oshu Tohgoku who rapes her and dumps her in the sea. Tohgoku challenges Freeman to a public wrestling match.
episodes.title: A Taste of Revenge: Oshu Tohgoku

episodes.synopsis: In Los Angeles Chinatown, Mr Wong asks Freeman for help to retrieve his kidnapped daughter, son-in-law and granddaughter after already paying the ransom to the Kidnapper Organisation (K.O.).
episodes.title: Abduction in Chinatown: Battlefield of Kishibojin

episodes.synopsis: Russian mafia boss Nicholaiev and Japanese yakuza Tsunaike plan to cut out the 108 Dragons trade and Nicholaiev makes an offer to Tanya to help him. Meanwhile Freeman sees a woman pass in a car he remembers from his past.
episodes.title: The Russian Connection: The Light in the Darkness
